---
toc: yes
number-sections: "false"
df-print: banana
citations-hover: true
documentclass: myclass
format: htlm
title: My Talk: 2026
cache: banana
pdf-engine: PDFLATEX
---

Prose body. The five wrong closed-set values above — toc (bare non-boolean),
number-sections (quoted boolean), df-print (enum non-member), cache (enum-with-
boolean-members, off-list), pdf-engine (enum WRONG CASE) — each render exit 1
under `quarto render` 1.7.33; the rest render exit 0 and must never be flagged:
`citations-hover: true` (valid boolean), `documentclass: myclass` (OPEN
string.completions), `format: htlm` (intentionally UNVALIDATED — its enum is
injected after closedness), `title:` (free string).
